articles.title: Vantage Data Centers Eyes IPO At $100 Bn Valuation Or Sale As AI Demand Boosts Sector
articles.description: Vantage Data Centers is weighing several potential exit options, including an initial public offering (IPO) or a sale, as soon as next year. One possible route could involve raising about $10 billion through a stock market listing that values the hyperscale data centre developer and operator at around $100 billion, as per a report by Reuters. Such a transaction would rank as the largest data centre IPO to date. The company is also considering alternatives including an outright sale or the sale of a stake, the report said.

insights.text: Vantage Data Centers가 AI 수요 증가에 힘입어 IPO 또는 매각을 고려하고 있다.
Vantage Data Centers의 IPO는 약 100억 달러 가치로 이루어질 수 있으며 이는 최대 규모의 데이터 센터 IPO가 될 수 있다.
Vantage Data Centers는 주식시장 상장을 통한 100억 달러 가치 IPO 외에도 직접 매각이나 일부 지분 매각 등 다양한 출구 전략을 고려하고 있다.

articles.title: We Are Incentivising Private Sector For AI Ecosystem: Abhishek Singh
articles.description: We have 62,000 GPUs. That was sufficient for training the first set of models, says MeitY's Abhishek Singh. Given the size of our country, if 10-20 crore people start using these services for various purposes, we will need to upend the backend infrastructure. 100,000 to 200,00 GPUs will be minimum we will need to meet the demand of India, added Singh. We are coming with a policy which incentivises the private sector to invest into the compute infrastructure. Part of GPUs will be offered by private sector incentivised by govt for the larger AI ecosystem, Singh said further.

insights.text: 인공지능 모델을 처음 학습시키는데 필요한 그래픽 처리 장치(GPU)는 62,000개가 필요하다.
인도의 인구 규모를 고려할 때, 다양한 용도로 GPU 서비스를 사용하는 인구가 1억명에서 2억명까지 늘어나면 후방 인프라를 크게 개선해야 한다.
인도 AI 생태계를 위해 정부는 민간 부문에 GPU 인프라 투자를 유도하기 위한 정책을 발표할 예정이다.

articles.title: Greek Banks Bet €4 Billion on AI - From Mobile Banking to the Bank That Knows What You Need
articles.description: The next big battle for Greece’s banks will not be fought in branches but in algorithms. National Bank of Greece, Eurobank, Piraeus and Alpha Bank are sharply increasing technology investment, with multi-year spending programs that together run into the billions. Artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity and automation are reshaping banking from a digital service into something far more personalized: a bank that can anticipate what a customer needs before they ask. articles.title: "Je ne l'ai jamais dit avant" : en pleine tournée mondiale, V du groupe BTS révèle avoir perdu une partie de son audition
articles.description: [VIDÉO] ▶️ De son vrai nom Kim Tae-hyung, la superstar de la K-pop V s’est laissée aller à des confidences inattendues lors d'un live avec son collègue Jung Kook. Le chanteur de 30 ans a évoqué ses problèmes de santé, indiquant que les capacités auditives de son oreille droite n’étaient plus que de "30%". Suivi par des médecins à l’hôpital, il explique que la situation s’est détériorée pendant son service militaire obligatoire. - "Je ne l'ai jamais dit avant" : en pleine tournée mondiale, V du groupe BTS révèle avoir perdu une partie de son audition (Culture, médias et divertissement).
